resources.string: Independent helper tool for operational documentation at Sekolah Rakyat. Not an official application of the Ministry of Social Affairs RI or Sekolah Rakyat.

Wali Asuh Care is independently developed to assist Wali Asuh and Asrama managers with operational health documentation at Sekolah Rakyat. This application does not belong to and is not officially affiliated with the Ministry of Social Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia or Sekolah Rakyat institutions.
Printed via Wali Asuh Care operational documentation tool (independent, not an official system of Kemensos RI / Sekolah Rakyat).
